body.statement: Two directed acyclic graphs on the same finite vertex set entail exactly the same d-separation relations if and only if they have the same undirected skeleton and the same unshielded collider triples.

source.locator: Section 2, Markov equivalence and latent-DAG recovery setup
source.verbatim_statement: Theorem 1 Two dags are equivalent if and only if they have the same links and same uncoupled head-to-head nodes.

upstream.citation: T. Verma and J. Pearl, Equivalence and Synthesis of Causal Models, UAI 1990, arXiv:1304.1108

attestation.note: The cited Kivva paper invokes standard d-separation and latent-DAG recovery; the exact characterization was checked in the original Verma–Pearl paper via the authors arXiv archival copy on 2026-09-12. Links are the skeleton and uncoupled head-to-head nodes are unshielded colliders.
